categories.name_ar: الأفعال المعتلة: مثال وأجوف وناقص ولفيف

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعَلَ (Form I perfect active verb) / فُعُل (Broken plural)
queries.description: Foundational baseline benchmark for regular triliteral morphology. Probes the ability to bridge verbal inflections, nominal derivations, and broken plurals.

relevance_criteria.0: Unrelated document or severe semantic collision (e.g. military battalion 'كتيبة').
relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of writing, books, or documentation without thematic focus.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantive discussion of authorship, libraries, literature, or books.
relevance_criteria.3: Authoritative article specifically focused on books, libraries, writing systems, or authorship.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Matches only verbatim 'كتب'. Fails on inflected verbs and derived nouns. Expected Recall < 5%.
expected_system_behavior.s1: Matches verbatim 'كتب' after stopword filtering. Recall remains < 5%.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips simple affixes. Matches 'كتب', 'يكتب' (partially). Fails on 'مكتبة', 'مكاتب'. Moderate Precision, low-to-medium Recall.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'كتب' via patterns. Retrieves verbal and nominal forms. High Recall.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja validates against lexicon root 'كتب'. Retrieves all derived forms. Highest Recall, moderate over-stemming.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Trigram matching captures character substrings with varying similarity scores. Moderate precision, high computational cost.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate-to-High. Root stemmers (S3/S4) conflate 'كتيبة' (military battalion) and 'مكتب' (office/bureau) with 'كتاب' (book), degrading P@10.

queries.description: Sound root representing education and pedagogy. Tests derivation across schools, students, studying, and teaching.

relevance_criteria.1: Incidental mention of a school or study in a biography or historical article.
relevance_criteria.2: Discussion of educational systems, pedagogical methods, or academic studies.
relevance_criteria.3: Dedicated article on educational institutions, academic disciplines, or schools.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Fails on all derivations. Zero recall for 'مدرسة' or 'دراسة'.
expected_system_behavior.s1: Identical to S0; zero recall on derived vocabulary.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Captures 'دارس', 'يدرس'. Fails to connect 'مدرسة' or broken plural 'مدارس'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: Extracts root 'درس'. Retrieves 'مدرسة', 'دراسة', 'تدريس'. High Recall.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja root match succeeds. Captures educational corpus comprehensively.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Matches overlapping trigrams for 'مدرس' and 'دراسة'; misses non-overlapping patterns.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate. S3/S4 conflates 'مدروس' (carefully calculated/planned) and agricultural threshing ('درس المحصول') with pedagogical education.

queries.description: Legal, political, and philosophical sound root. Features wide semantic dispersion across government, courts, wisdom, and arbitration.

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of a ruling, wise quote, or administrative rule.
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed analysis of governance, legal rulings, judicial systems, or political regimes.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive treatise on political governance, constitutional law, or judicial authority.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Matches only exact token 'حكم'. Misses 'حكومة' and 'محكمة'.
expected_system_behavior.s1: Eliminates prepositions; exact token match only.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips inflectional affixes; matches 'حاكم', 'حكومة'. Fails on broken plural 'محاكم'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'حكم'. Unifies courts, governance, and wisdom.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja maps all terms to root 'حكم'. Highest Recall.

queries.over_stemming_risk: High. Severe semantic drift between 'حكومة' (executive government), 'محكمة' (judicial court), and 'حكيم' (sage/philosopher). Causes substantial P@10 drop.

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعَلَ (Form I) / اِسْتَفْعَلَ (Form X) / مَفْعَل (Noun of place)
queries.description: Tests derived verbal forms (particularly Form X 'استخراج') and spatial nominalization ('مخرج', 'مخارج').

relevance_criteria.1: Incidental mention of graduation, exiting, or extraction.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantive article discussing foreign policy, natural resource extraction, or theatrical direction.
relevance_criteria.3: Dedicated topic regarding foreign relations ('وزارة الخارجية'), cinematic directing, or mineral extraction.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Captures 'خارج', 'يخرجون'. Fails on Form X 'استخراج' and broken plural 'مخارج'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: Accurately strips Form X prefixes ('است-') and patterns to root 'خرج'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja correctly extracts root 'خرج'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Very High. Conflates 'خارجية' (foreign diplomacy), 'مخرج' (film director), 'تخرج' (academic graduation), and 'استخراج النفط' (petroleum extraction).

queries.description: High-frequency polysemic root representing knowledge, education, media, and the universe. Key benchmark for precision degradation.

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of a scientist, teacher, or media outlet.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial discussion of scientific disciplines, educational theory, or information science.
relevance_criteria.3: Core encyclopedic article dedicated to science, knowledge theory, or educational pedagogy.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Keeps 'تعليم' and 'عالم' distinct. Maintains high precision on specific senses.
expected_system_behavior.s3: Collapses all occurrences into root 'علم'. Massive recall explosion.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Lexicon validation succeeds on 'علم'. Huge recall, massive false positive pool.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Trigram matching yields large number of ambiguous candidates.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Extreme. S3/S4 merges 'عَالَم' (universe/world), 'عِلْم' (science), 'تَعْلِيم' (education), and 'إِعْلَام' (mass media), collapsing P@10.

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعَلَ / سَافَرَ (Form III) مع سوابق ولواحق
queries.description: Evaluates heavy proclitic chaining (conjunction 'و', future marker 'س', present prefix 'ي', plural suffix 'ون').

relevance_criteria.1: Minor reference to traveling or an embassy.
relevance_criteria.2: Discussion of travel, transportation, tourism, or diplomatic embassies.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive article on international travel, tourism industry, or diplomatic missions.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Larkey light10 iteratively strips 'و+س' and 'ون', successfully matching 'سافر'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI strips affixes and patterns down to root 'سفر'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja validates candidate against root 'سفر'.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Poor trigram overlap with heavily prefixed 'وسيسافرون'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate. Root stemmers merge 'سفارة' (diplomatic embassy) and biblical 'أسفار' (books of scripture) with mundane travel ('سفر').

queries.description: Probes non-concatenative infixation where the reflexive marker '-ت-' is inserted between root radicals (e.g. 'فانتصروا').

relevance_criteria.1: Brief mention of a victory or support in a conflict.
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed historical account of military victories, triumphs, or alliances.
relevance_criteria.3: Authoritative historical analysis of military battles, triumphs, or doctrine of victory.

expected_system_behavior.s1: Zero match on inflected or infixed forms.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Light stemmer strips 'فـ' and 'وا', leaving 'انتصر'. Fails to remove infixed '-ت-'. Cannot match query 'نصر'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI applies Form VIII template 'افتعل' -> successfully extracts root 'نصر'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja morphological pattern analysis correctly strips infixed '-ت-' -> extracts 'نصر'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: High. Root stemmers conflate 'نصرانية' (Christianity), 'الناصرة' (Nazareth), and 'انتصار' (military victory).

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعَلَ / فَعَّلَ / اِسْتَفْعَلَ مع ضمائر متصلة
queries.description: Tests pronominal enclitic attachments ('-هم', '-نا', '-ها') combined with prepositions ('بـ') and dual/plural markers.

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of labor or operations.
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed discussion of labor economics, employment, or operational processes.
relevance_criteria.3: Core encyclopedic article on labor rights, industrial work, or economic employment.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Larkey light10 effectively strips 'بالـ', '-ية', '-هم', and dual '-ان'. High performance.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'عمل'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'عمل'.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Trigram matching captures partial substrings on long words like 'يستعملونها'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: High. S3/S4 conflates 'معمل/معامل' (chemical laboratories/factories) with 'معاملة' (personal treatment/transaction) and 'عمالة' (workforce).

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعَلَ / أَفْعَلَ / اِسْتَفْعَلَ مع سوابق ولواحق متعددة
queries.description: Probes multi-layer agglutination ('وسيسلمونها' = conjunction + future + present prefix + stem + plural + direct object pronoun).

relevance_criteria.1: Passing reference to peace, delivery, or safety.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial article on peace treaties, peaceful conflict resolution, or surrender.
relevance_criteria.3: Major historical or political article dedicated to peace treaties ('معاهدات السلام') or pacificism.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Zero match on complex compound forms.
expected_system_behavior.s2: May fail on 'وسيسلمونها' due to deep prefix/suffix nesting exceeding single-pass limits.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI heuristic stripping penetrates nested clitics to extract root 'سلم'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'سلم'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Catastrophic. S3/S4 merges 'إسلام' (Islam / religious theology), 'استسلام' (military surrender), 'سلامة' (industrial safety), and 'سُلَّم' (physical ladder).

queries.description: Archetypal benchmark for broken plurals. Tests the non-concatenative plural 'أشجار' against singular 'شجرة' and collective 'شجر'.

relevance_criteria.1: Passing reference to trees in a geographical description.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial discussion of forestry, botanical trees, or afforestation.
relevance_criteria.3: Encyclopedic article dedicated to trees, arboriculture, or forest ecology.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Reduces 'الأشجار' to 'أشجار' and 'شجرة' to 'شجر'. Fails to connect 'أشجار' with query 'شجر'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI maps pattern 'أفعال' to root -> extracts 'شجر'. Successfully connects singular and plural.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja correctly extracts root 'شجر' across all forms. Demonstrates clear superiority over light stemming.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Very Low. Semantic cohesion remains tightly bounded within botanical and forestry contexts.

queries.linguistic_pattern: فُعُول (Broken plural: قلوب) / اِنْفِعَال (Form VII: انقلاب)
queries.description: Broken plural 'قلوب' and Form VII nominalization 'انقلاب'. High morphological variance and dramatic semantic divergence.

relevance_criteria.1: Metaphorical use of 'قلب' (e.g. in the heart of the city).
relevance_criteria.2: Discussion of cardiology, heart anatomy, or cardiovascular diseases.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive medical or biological article on the mammalian heart ('عضلة القلب').

expected_system_behavior.s2: Matches 'قلبي'. Fails on broken plural 'قلوب' and Form VII 'انقلاب'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'قلب' across all variants.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'قلب'. Highest recall.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Critical. Root stemmers (S3/S4) merge cardiology ('أمراض القلب') with military coups ('انقلاب عسكري') and meteorological fluctuations ('تقلبات جوية').

queries.linguistic_pattern: فُعُل (Broken plural: طرق) / فَعَائِل (Broken plural: طرائق) / مِفْعَلَة (Tool: مطرقة)
queries.description: Multiple broken plural patterns for road ('طريق' -> 'طرق') and method ('طريقة' -> 'طرائق'), plus instrument noun ('مطرقة').

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of a road or methodology.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial discussion of road networks, transportation infrastructure, or systematic methods.
relevance_criteria.3: Core article on highway engineering, transportation infrastructure, or formal methodology.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Fails to equate 'طريقة' or 'طريق' with broken plural 'طرائق'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'طرق' for both broken plurals and tool nouns.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'طرق'. High recall.

queries.over_stemming_risk: High. S3/S4 conflates physical highways ('طرق معبدة'), scientific methodologies ('طرائق البحث'), blacksmith tools ('مطرقة'), and the historical figure 'طارق بن زياد'.

queries.description: Broken plurals of companionship. Tests religious/historical terminology ('الصحابة') against secular companionship ('أصحاب', 'صاحب').

relevance_criteria.1: Incidental mention of friends or associates.
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed historical/theological discussion of the Companions of the Prophet or companionship ethics.
relevance_criteria.3: Dedicated article on the Companions of the Prophet ('الصحابة') in Islamic history.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips 'الـ' to leave 'صحابة' and 'أصحاب'; cannot reduce to root 'صحب'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI identifies broken plural patterns and extracts root 'صحب'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'صحب'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate-to-High. Merges specific historical entities ('صحابة رسول الله') with general proprietary usage ('أصحاب الشركات').

queries.root_type: معتل أجوف (Hollow Root: Middle Radical Weak)
queries.category_name_ar: الأفعال المعتلة: مثال وأجوف وناقص ولفيف
queries.description: Classic hollow verb benchmark. The middle radical alternates between Alif ('قال'), Waw ('يقول', 'أقوال', 'مقولة'), and Yaa in passive ('قيل').

relevance_criteria.1: Direct quotation attribution ('قال فلان').
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial discussion of journalistic essays, aphorisms, or linguistic sayings.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive article on journalistic essay writing ('فن المقالة') or philosophical maxims.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Fails completely. 'قال' has 0% match against 'يقول' or 'أقوال'.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Fails completely. Light stemmer leaves 'قال' and 'يقول' with distinct radical vowels.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI applies hollow verb restoration rules to extract root 'قول'. High recall.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja validates candidate against root 'قول'. Connects 'قال' to 'يقول' and 'مقالة'.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Poor trigram overlap between 'قال' and 'يقول' (share only 'ق').

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate. Root extraction successfully restores morphological connection, but retrieves massive noise from ubiquitous narrative attribution.

queries.root_type: معتل مثال (Assimilated Root: Initial Radical Weak)
queries.category_name_ar: الأفعال المعتلة: مثال وأجوف وناقص ولفيف
queries.description: Assimilated verb where the initial radical 'و' drops completely in the imperfect tense ('يقف' instead of 'يوقف').

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of stopping or standing.
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed discussion of religious endowments ('أوقاف') or legal arrest procedures.
relevance_criteria.3: Dedicated legal or historical article on Islamic endowment trusts ('الوقف الإسلامي').

expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips 'يـ' from 'يقف' leaving 2-letter stem 'قف' (fails min length 3 constraint). Cannot match 'وقف'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI weak-verb heuristic reconstructs initial 'و' -> maps 'يقف' to root 'وقف'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja dictionary lookup restores root 'وقف'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: High. Severe divergence between religious endowments ('وزارة الأوقاف'), physical parking ('موقف سيارات'), political stances, and police custody ('توقيف').

queries.root_type: معتل ناقص (Defective Root: Final Radical Weak)
queries.category_name_ar: الأفعال المعتلة: مثال وأجوف وناقص ولفيف
queries.description: Defective verb with weak final radical (Alif Maqsura 'ى' / Yaa 'ي'). Tests broken plurals ('رماة') and sports nouns of place ('مرمى').

relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of archery or throwing.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial article on the sport of archery, military archers, or football goal analysis.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive article dedicated to the sport of archery ('رياضة الرماية') or historical archers.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Matches 'رامي' (after ya normalization). Fails on broken plural 'رماة' and past plural 'رموا'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI extracts root 'رمي'.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja extracts root 'رمي'. High recall.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Very low trigram similarity between 'رمى' and 'رماة'.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Moderate. Conflates sports archery ('رماية'), soccer goal/goalkeeper ('حارس المرمى'), and projectile weapon firing.

queries.root_type: معتل لفيف مفروق (Doubly Weak: Initial and Final Weak)
queries.category_name_ar: الأفعال المعتلة: مثال وأجوف وناقص ولفيف
queries.description: Doubly weak root ('و' and 'ي'). In present tense 'يفي', both weak letters are affected; in passive 'توفي', it denotes death.

relevance_criteria.1: Passing biographical death notice ('توفي عام...').
relevance_criteria.2: Detailed demographic study of mortality rates, or ethical analysis of loyalty/fulfillment.
relevance_criteria.3: Authoritative demographic/medical research on mortality statistics ('معدل الوفيات') or virtue of loyalty.

expected_system_behavior.s2: Fails completely on 'يفي' (stripped to single letter) and 'توفي'.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI struggles with doubly weak roots, prone to irregular pattern assignment.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja dictionary contains root 'وفي' and correctly maps candidate roots.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Severe. Catastrophic collision between moral virtue 'وفاء' (loyalty/faithfulness) and demographic mortality 'وفيات' (deaths).

queries.description: Canonical Arabic homonym (المشترك اللفظي). Senses include anatomical eye, water spring, intelligence spy, and dignitary/noble.

relevance_criteria.0: Documents on government appointment ('تعيين') or inspection ('معاينة').
relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of eyes or vision.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial article on human ophthalmology or natural water springs.
relevance_criteria.3: Encyclopedic treatise on the human eye anatomy ('عين الإنسان') and ophthalmology.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Matches verbatim 'عين' only. High precision on isolated noun, misses plural 'عيون'.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips clitics from 'بالعين' -> matches 'عين'. Leaves 'تعيين' and 'معاينة' distinct. Preserves reasonable precision.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI collapses 'تعيين', 'معاينة', and 'أعيان' into root 'عين'. Precision collapses.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja collapses all occurrences into root 'عين'. Catastrophic drop in P@10.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Trigram matches surface substrings with high ambiguity.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Extreme. Definitive homonymy benchmark. In S3/S4, querying anatomical eye retrieves water springs ('عين ماء'), espionage ('عين على العدو'), and job appointments ('تعيين وزاري').

queries.linguistic_pattern: فَعْر (شَعْر: Hair) / فِعْل (شِعْر: Poetry) / فُعُول (شُعُور: Emotion)
queries.description: Major semantic branching benchmark. Distinguishes biological hair ('شَعْر'), literary poetry ('شِعْر'), emotion ('شُعُور'), and notification ('إشعار').

relevance_criteria.0: Documents discussing human hair/dermatology, emotional psychology, or bank notifications.
relevance_criteria.1: Passing quotation of a poetic verse.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial critique of Arabic poetic forms, metrics, or famous poets.
relevance_criteria.3: Comprehensive literary treatise on Arabic poetry ('الشعر العربي') and poetic meters.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Matches unvocalized surface 'شعر'. Cannot distinguish hair from poetry.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Distinguishes 'شاعر' (poet) and 'أشعار' from 'مشاعر' (feelings). Maintains superior P@10.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI maps 'شاعر', 'شعراء', 'شعور', 'مشاعر', and 'إشعار' to root 'شعر'. P@10 plunges.
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja merges all concepts under root 'شعر'. Massive semantic contamination.
expected_system_behavior.s5: Trigram matches substrings across all senses indiscriminately.

queries.over_stemming_risk: Extreme. S3/S4 Precision degrades by >50% due to cross-contamination between literature (poetry), biology (hair), and psychology (emotions).

queries.root_type: سالم مع انزلاق أسماء الأعلام (Proper Noun Drift)
queries.description: Probes root stemmer susceptibility to false morphological reduction of proper nouns and geopolitical entities (specifically the sovereign Kingdom of Bahrain 'البحرين').

relevance_criteria.0: Articles on the Kingdom of Bahrain, domestic politics of Manama, or unrelated geographic topics.
relevance_criteria.1: Passing mention of the sea in a travelogue.
relevance_criteria.2: Substantial discussion of marine biology, oceanography, or maritime navigation.
relevance_criteria.3: Authoritative encyclopedic article on oceanography, maritime ecology, or the Mediterranean/Red Sea.

expected_system_behavior.s0: Matches verbatim 'بحر' only. Does not match 'البحرين'. High precision on marine topic.
expected_system_behavior.s2: Strips 'الـ' from 'البحرين' leaving 'بحرين'. Recognizes it as distinct from 'بحر'. Preserves precision.
expected_system_behavior.s3: ISRI strips suffix '-ين' (treating as dual/plural) and prefix 'الـ' -> forcibly stems country 'البحرين' to root 'بحر'!
expected_system_behavior.s4: Khoja validates candidate root 'بحر' against dictionary -> stems 'البحرين' to 'بحر'!

queries.over_stemming_risk: Catastrophic. Root stemmers (S3/S4) stem the geopolitical nation-state 'البحرين' (Bahrain) to root 'بحر' (sea), causing total topical contamination between sovereign politics and marine biology.
